_about: The English wording of the ORIGINAL app that reads badly, points at controls that are gone, or says something the app does not know. Only locale-en.json is changed; the other 16 languages are not. Keys that start with an underscore are comments. Every key has to exist in locale-en.json (patch-21-copy.py stops otherwise).
_1_failures_of_commands: The text of the alert after a failed Open, Close or Stop (and of every other failure that uses the same key): what the accessory said, whether the command may have arrived, and what to do. Each text is also true when the failure is not about a command (the alert after entering the screen). A code that has no text at all gets 'The accessory reported error n. Check the gate.' from nx-patch.js (section nx23 copy). The key of 11 (the accessory is full) is new, hence the plus sign: the original app has no text for it.
NHK_ERROR-TIMEOUT: No answer from the accessory. If you just sent a command, it may have arrived: check the gate, then try again.
NHK_ERROR-BAD_RESPONSE: The accessory sent an answer that the app could not read. If you just sent a command, it may have arrived: check the gate, then try again.
NHK_ERROR-COMM_ERR: Communication with the accessory failed. If you just sent a command, it may have arrived: check the gate, then try again.
NHK_ERROR-3: The connection to the accessory was lost. If you just sent a command, it was not confirmed: check the gate, then try again.
NHK_ERROR-NOT_CONNECTED: The app is not connected to the accessory. If you just sent a command, it was not confirmed: check the gate, then try again.
NHK_ERROR-NO_SESSION: The connection to the accessory has expired. If you just sent a command, it was not confirmed: check the gate, then try again.
NHK_ERROR-4: The accessory did not accept the request. If you just sent a command, it was not carried out: try again.
NHK_ERROR-007: The accessory cannot reach the gate controller. If you just sent a command, it was not carried out: check the gate, then try again.
NHK_ERROR-8: The accessory reported an error. If you just sent a command, check the gate, then try again.
+NHK_ERROR-11: The accessory has reached its maximum number of users. Ask an administrator to remove one, then try again.
_2_one_word_per_thing: 'Not usable' is the app's word for what the status chip calls 'not reachable' ('unknown' stays for the state of the gate). 'Waiting for confirm', 'Users management' and 'Historian of events' are calques of the Italian original; 'Go ahead' and 'Complete' are the labels of buttons.
HOME_SETTINGS_BTN_DELETE_DEVICE_MSG_CONF: The accessory is not reachable. Do you want to delete it from the app?
SETTINGS_DEVICE_DETAIL_MSG_CONFIRMATION_: Waiting for the administrator to confirm…
NHK_ERROR-NO-OTHER-ADMIN-FOUND:
Before deleting, you have to elect a new administrator for the Accessory/Accessories. Go to Settings > User management, select the Accessory, select the user you want to elect as administrator and change the role from user to administrator.

If you enabled IFTTT service, remember to disable it
_3_page_titles: The two tab roots, System and Settings, were both called 'Nice'. The titles that are raw ids are in templates.json.
_4_slips_in_setup_and_pairing: Slips and Italian leftovers on the sign-up, pairing and identify pages; 'tap on <' pointed at a back control that is an arrow now.
INFO_SIGN_UP: Enter Username and Description to identify the user.
START_EMAIL_MSG_DEFAULT_IFTTT_USER: This username is not valid. Please choose another one.
USER_PAIRING_REQUEST_MESSAGE:
This accessory is already associated with at least one other user.

If you want to use it, tap Next to send a request to the administrator of the accessory.
To cancel, tap the back arrow.
USER_PAIRING_REQUESTED_MESSAGE:
Your request has been sent to the administrator of the accessory.

You can use the accessory as soon as the administrator allows it.
ADD_DEVICE_SETUP_RESET_DEVICE_MSG: You are already registered on this accessory, but it is not in the app. If you are the only administrator of the accessory, you must reset it with the button on the accessory. Otherwise, continue and ask an administrator to give you permission to use it.
BRIDGE_INVID_TXT1: Tap Next to connect it to
_5_updates_of_the_accessory: The alerts of Settings > Accessory > About > Update.
ABOUT_DEVICE_FIRMWARE_LAST_VERSION_MSG: The accessory is already up to date.
ABOUT_DEVICE_FIRMWARE_UPDATED_MSG: Update completed. Your accessory is going to reboot. Please wait…
ERROR_NO_WIFI_CONNECTION: To update the accessory, you need an active internet connection.
_6_one_ellipsis_and_one_Wi_Fi: The patches write the ellipsis as one character and Wi-Fi with a hyphen; the original wrote three dots and WiFi. Only texts that a template shows are listed here (the messages of the loading overlay belong to the setup).
BENVENUTO_SPIEGA: We will help you set up your Nice accessory with Wi-Fi technology.
COLL_WIFI_BRIDGE: We are connecting your accessory to your home Wi-Fi network. This could take a few minutes.
_7_qa_screens: nx23 QA (screens): what the merged build still said in two voices. The alert after a failed command says what the line on the gate screen says ('it may have arrived: check the gate'; the first draft said 'may not'); the page of the other commands has one name (the button that opens it is called 'More commands'); the pages of the event history say 'Accessory events' and 'Scene events'; the loading messages (the overlay of every wait) use the one-character ellipsis like the rest and say Accessory where they said Device; five more alerts and confirmations (the network error, the wrong code, the full stop of the reset and of the configuration, 'Are you sure to allow') lose the Italian punctuation.
NHK_ERROR-15: The accessory is not ready yet. Wait a moment, then try again.
NHK_ERROR-2_WRONG_CODE: That code is not correct. Check the label on the accessory and try again.
ADD_NEW_DEVICE_MSG_NETWORK_ERROR: A network error occurred. Please try again.
COMMON_MSG_USER_PERMISSION_CHANGES: Some of your user settings have changed.
ADD_DEVICE_SETUP_WAITING_MSG_JOIN_HOME_N: Access to the network in progress. Please wait…
ADD_DEVICE_SETUP_WAITING_MSG_DEVICE_FOUN: Configuration of the Accessory in progress. Please wait…

ADD_NEW_DEVICE_CONFIRM_RESET_HAP: Are you sure you want to proceed with the configuration of this accessory? The procedure can last about a minute.
DEVICE_USERS_ASSOCIATION_ALERT_ENROLL_US: Are you sure you want to allow this user to control your accessory?
